in_hebrew.name: Basila
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Basila הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'basileus', meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. The name Basila was popular among early Christians, symbolizing spiritual royalty and nobility.
